description: Set personal tags on a file or folder in Nextcloud. Replaces all existing personal tags. Use an empty array to clear all tags.

path.description: The file or folder path in Nextcloud (e.g., '/Photos/test.png')

tags.description: Array of tag names to set (e.g., ['Wallpapers', 'Nature'])

name: set_file_tags
title: Set File Tags
